title: S&P 500 Dividend Yield
revision_note: Shiller periodically restates historical dividend figures; the site always shows the latest revision.
methodology: Dividend yield = trailing 12-month S&P Composite dividend per share / monthly average price, both read from Shiller's ie_data.xls (columns D and P).

Shiller interpolates monthly dividend figures between quarter-end anchors the same way he does earnings (see the S&P 500 P/E chart's methodology); a month appears here once he has published it, with no forward-fill beyond that.
The current, not-yet-completed month is never included.
notes: Built for S9b/S10 (equity-valuation roadmap) alongside CAPE and earnings yield, all read from the same ie_data.xls download.

Not published on joemirza.com: Shiller's terms are unknown (no statement on the Yale page or shillerdata.com), and the underlying price and dividend columns are S&P's. presentation.publish is false pending an answer from shillerdata.com's maintainer (asked 2026-09-16); scripts/dev.sh builds it locally regardless.

presentation.summary: Monthly S&P 500 trailing dividend yield, Shiller/Yale data back to 1871.
